submission.justification: D2 has the highest light yield but fails thermal cycling (30% failures against a 5% limit). Modules can't be accessed once the cryostat is filled, so D2 is excluded. Of the two remaining designs, D1 gives more light than D3 at 30% coverage (37.3 against 25.0 PE/MeV). D1's failure rate is 2%, within the limit. 30% coverage is the maximum allowed, and the feedthroughs support it.

requirements.evidence: Among designs that pass robustness, D1 at 30% gives 37.3 PE/MeV in simulation, against 25.0 for D3. D2 would be higher but is excluded.

requirements.requirement: Robust, inaccessible after fill (<=5% failures after 20 thermal cycles)
requirements.evidence: D1 had 2% failures in a 40-module batch. D2 had 30% and D3 had 0.5%.

requirements.requirement: One of the three listed designs

requirements.evidence: 30%. The meeting notes confirm enough feedthroughs for up to 30%.
